fail.summary: Install a valid certificate that matches your domain and includes the full chain.

generic: If it has expired, renew it. Most hosts offer free automatic certificates (Let's Encrypt or similar) so this never lapses again.
If the name does not match, make sure the certificate lists your exact domain (and www if you use it).
If the chain is incomplete, install the certificate bundle or 'full chain' file from your provider, not just the single certificate.
cpanel: In cPanel open SSL/TLS Status, select the domain and click Run AutoSSL.
If AutoSSL fails, check that the domain's DNS points at this server.

warn.summary: Renew the certificate before it expires.

generic: Renew or reissue the certificate now.
Turn on automatic renewal at your host or certificate provider so this does not recur.
cpanel: In cPanel open SSL/TLS Status and run AutoSSL. It renews certificates automatically when it can.
